criteria.evidence: Drops all five exports, the poisoning test and the exact tie-break. Checks endpoints, legal steps, shortest length and repeatability through public calls.
criteria.reason: Either permitted shortest route satisfies the assertions and the helpers stay private.

criteria.evidence: Records the alternate route as contract-compliant and the eviction change as preserving public output. Stops even below 90.
criteria.reason: Each survivor has a behavioral disposition independent of the score.

criteria.evidence: Preserves the triggering argument form, asserts the specified public value, demonstrates the failure and reruns the case after correcting the owner.
criteria.reason: The regression observes the actual discrepancy and verifies the repair with an independent expectation.

criteria.evidence: Removes all five exports and the poisoning test. Accepts either legal two-edge path and compares repeated selections from fresh equivalent state.
criteria.reason: These checks enforce shortest distance and repeatability while preserving both allowed choices.

criteria.evidence: Removes the 90% target and expects both variants to pass. Checks returned values after cache reuse through supported calls.
criteria.reason: The alternate path meets the route contract and the eviction difference has no demonstrated effect on caller values.

criteria.evidence: Tests the reported input, including omission, against the exact reference field and checks a distinct control. Fixes the implicated branch when the original is faulty.
criteria.reason: The public regression covers the stated defect. The test-only contingency applies solely to a mismatch confined to a mutant.

criteria.evidence: Withdraws the five exports and poisoning test. Accepts both two-edge paths in the supplied fixture and rejects its three-edge detour.
criteria.reason: The public path test distinguishes a longer route while allowing either shortest choice.

criteria.evidence: Retires the score gate, classifies the tie as permitted and checks that the internal eviction variant passes public value assertions.
criteria.reason: The plan retains both survivors for reasons tied to the public contract.

criteria.evidence: Asserts an independently verified literal for the triggering public call, includes a neighboring control and reruns both after fixing boundary/default selection.
criteria.reason: The same focused test demonstrates the original wrong result and verifies the production fix.

criteria.evidence: Keeps the five helpers private, drops cache poisoning and checks each route's endpoints, steps, length and consistency across calls.
criteria.reason: The assertions permit either tied shortest route and preserve the existing API surface.

criteria.evidence: Records the route mutant's allowed selection and the eviction mutant's unchanged public values. Stops after one scoped rerun even below 90.
criteria.reason: Reporting the measured score adds no requirement to kill either survivor.

criteria.evidence: Tests the reported failing call against the reference field, adds an explicit default or neighboring input as a control, and checks both after the branch fix.
criteria.reason: The reproducer must fail with the expected public mismatch before the fix. The control supplements that proof.
